integrity: The conventional shifted-square preconditioner and universal factor-two bound are credited to earlier literature; only the finite-band exact minimax shift, sharp extremizer, and endpoint spectral collapse are assessed as the present contribution.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-dimensional Euclidean model; self-adjoint positive-semidefinite dynamics, identity state observation and control coupling, known finite spectral interval, positive regularization, scalar feedback; excludes inexact solves, PDE energy norms, cost of inverse applications, and nonsymmetric dynamics.
title: Sharp minimax feedback shifts for bounded self-adjoint control spectra
